answer_1.quote: Informative text summarization aims to shorten a long piece of text while preserving its main message.
answer_1.outputs: abstractive summaries, corrected summaries with factual edits on entities

answer_2.quote: We use three automatic evaluation metrics to evaluate our models. The first is ROUGE, the standard summarization quality metric... we use two additional automatic metrics that specifically focus on factual consistency: FactCC and QAGS.

answer_4.quote: We select three state-of-the-art abstractive summarization models as the backbones, and collect three sets of pairwise summaries for each setting... Nine sets of 50 randomly selected samples (total 450 samples) are labeled by AMT tuckers. For each pair (in anonymized order), three annotators from Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) are asked to judge which is more factually correct based on the source document.
answer_4.guideline: For each pair (in anonymized order), three annotators from Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) are asked to judge which is more factually correct based on the source document.
